profile.headline: Leading Robust Software Delivery | Expertise in Architecture, Mentoring, and Modern Web Tools

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer - UI
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the architectural transformation of a legacy Backbone.js application to a modern React framework, enhancing performance and maintainability.  
• Developed a modular React UI application framework, reducing feature development time by 30% across 5+ product teams.  
• Established a reusable Material-UI component library, improving UI consistency and accelerating delivery by 25%.  
• Mentored a team of UI developers, boosting code quality metrics by 40% and promoting best practices organization-wide.
• Collaborated with the UX team to enhance and expand the Aktana Design System, resulting in a 50% reduction in design-to-development cycle time and a more cohesive user experience across all products.
• Partnered with product managers to define requirements and architect complex UI applications as chief UI platform architect, delivering 15+ major product releases from concept to implementation.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and maintained 3+ application frameworks supporting campaign and message design tools, enabling a 40% faster rollout of new features and scaling solutions across 5 product lines.
• Designed and implemented 20+ core UI components adopted by all application teams, standardizing development practices and reducing redundant code by 35%.
• Provided technical leadership and mentorship to a team of 5+ UI developers, increasing adoption of modular, extensible design patterns and improving code reusability metrics by 30%.
• Coordinated with product managers and engineering managers to groom and plan 100+ feature stories per year using Agile methodology, achieving a 95% on-time delivery rate.
• Developed and prioritized task estimates with developers, optimizing resource allocation and improving sprint capacity utilization by 20%.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, UI / Front End
positions.description:
• Prototyped and demoed 10+ core product features, reducing stakeholder feedback cycles by 40% and accelerating iterative development.
• Designed and built 5+ primary modules at the application framework level, providing robust foundations that supported the launch of 3 new products.
• Collaborated with product managers and senior engineers on 20+ feature design initiatives, directly influencing technical direction and product strategy.
• Led the upgrade of 100% of product UIs to a new version of Ext JS, improving performance benchmarks by 25% and ensuring full compatibility across platforms.
• Served as the key technical lead for UI, resolving over 20 complex issues per release and maintaining a 98% product quality rating across multiple launches.

positions.title: Project Leader
positions.description:
• Developed and stabilized 8+ core back-end modules for the Fusion CRM sales application, increasing system reliability by 30% and supporting scalability for over 50 enterprise customers.
• Researched and prototyped 3 integration methodologies for incorporating metrics into the Territory Management product, delivering actionable solutions that informed product leadership decisions and accelerated feature rollout.
• Proposed and implemented design resolutions for ESS/SOA reliability across the BPEL project, providing technical direction to 4 engineering teams and reducing system downtime incidents by 35%.
